definition.en: A wedge of cloth set into a slash or a seam from a point down to the hem, adding sweep at the hem and no width at all above the point where it starts. A godet is how a straight skirt buys movement it does not pay for at the waist: the apex is the rise, and everything the wedge adds lies below it.
definition.es: Una cuña de tela insertada en un corte o en una costura desde un punto hasta el bajo, que añade vuelo en el bajo y nada de ancho por encima del punto donde arranca. Un godet es la manera en que una falda recta compra movimiento sin pagarlo en la cintura: el vértice es la altura de arranque, y todo lo que la cuña añade queda por debajo.
definition.fr: Un coin de tissu inséré dans une fente ou une couture depuis un point jusqu'à l'ourlet, qui ajoute de l'ampleur en bas et aucune largeur au-dessus du point où il commence. Un godet est la façon dont une jupe droite achète du mouvement sans le payer à la taille : le sommet est la hauteur d'attaque, et tout ce que le coin ajoute se trouve en dessous.
definition.pt: Uma cunha de tecido inserida num corte ou numa costura desde um ponto até à bainha, que acrescenta roda na bainha e largura nenhuma acima do ponto onde começa. Um godê é como uma saia direita compra movimento sem o pagar na cintura: o vértice é a altura de arranque, e tudo o que a cunha acrescenta fica abaixo dele.

aliases.name: godet_rise
aliases.note: Parameter id on godet-skirt, with `godet_flare` and `godets` — the apex height, the width added at the hem, and the count. The `godet_seam` interface id is where the wedge is set in.

aliases.name: godet_flare
aliases.note: Also a hyperobject.capabilities flag, glossed by the vocabulary as flare added by inserting godets into the lower seams rather than by widening the pieces — the same claim as a capability.

aliases.name: side_godet
aliases.note: hyperobject.interfaces[].id on jalabiya, declared under interface type `side_seam`: the wedge set into the side seam rather than into a slash.

constraints: The godet's two straight edges must equal the length of the slash or seam opened for it, measured from the rise down. The apex is a point and not a seam: placed by eye instead of measured off both edges, it leaves a pucker at the top of the wedge that no pressing removes.
